vocabulary.meaning: A close and trusting relationship between people

meaning_translation.Hindi: लोगों के बीच घनिष्ठ और भरोसेमंद संबंध
meaning_translation.Japanese: 人々の間の親しい信頼関係

examples.sentence: Their friendship has lasted for many years.

translation.Hindi: उनकी दोस्ती कई सालों तक चली है।
translation.Japanese: 彼らの友情は何年も続いています。

vocabulary.meaning: Believing someone is honest and reliable

meaning_translation.Hindi: यह मानना कि कोई ईमानदार और भरोसेमंद है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 相手が正直で頼れると信じること

examples.sentence: Trust is important in every relationship.

translation.Hindi: हर रिश्ते में विश्वास महत्वपूर्ण होता है।
translation.Japanese: 信頼はどんな関係にも大切です。

vocabulary.meaning: Helping someone in good or bad times

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी की अच्छे या बुरे समय में मदद करना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 良い時も悪い時も相手を助けること

examples.sentence: Good friends always support each other.

translation.Hindi: अच्छे दोस्त हमेशा एक-दूसरे का सहयोग करते हैं।
translation.Japanese: 親友はいつもお互いを支えます。

vocabulary.meaning: A disagreement or fight with words

meaning_translation.Hindi: शब्दों के साथ असहमति या झगड़ा
meaning_translation.Japanese: 言葉による意見の対立や口喧嘩

examples.sentence: They had an argument but became friends again.

translation.Hindi: उनकी बहस हुई लेकिन वे फिर से दोस्त बन गए।
translation.Japanese: 彼らは口論したが、また友達に戻りました。

vocabulary.meaning: Feeling or showing admiration for someone

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी के लिए प्रशंसा और आदर महसूस करना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 誰かに対して敬意を持ち示すこと

examples.sentence: Respect is the base of a healthy relationship.

translation.Hindi: सम्मान एक स्वस्थ संबंध का आधार है।
translation.Japanese: 尊敬は健全な関係の基盤です。

vocabulary.meaning: A very good and trusted friend

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक बहुत अच्छा और भरोसेमंद मित्र
meaning_translation.Japanese: とても良く信頼できる友達

examples.sentence: She is my closest friend since childhood.

translation.Hindi: वह बचपन से मेरी सबसे करीबी दोस्त है।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は子供のころからの親友です。

meaning_translation.Hindi: किसी के साथ संवाद जारी रखना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 誰かと連絡を続けること

examples.sentence: We stayed in touch after college.

translation.Hindi: हमने कॉलेज के बाद भी संपर्क बनाए रखा।
translation.Japanese: 私たちは大学卒業後も連絡を取り続けました。

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक प्रेम संबंध को खत्म करना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 恋愛関係を終わらせること

examples.sentence: They decided to break up after many arguments.

translation.Hindi: कई झगड़ों के बाद उन्होंने रिश्ता तोड़ने का फैसला किया।
translation.Japanese: 何度も口論した後、彼らは別れることに決めました。

grammar_tips.title: Using 'I have a friend who…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Use this to describe your friend. Example: I have a friend who loves music.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अपने दोस्त का वर्णन करने के लिए इसका प्रयोग करें। उदाहरण: I have a friend who loves music.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 友達を説明するときに使います。例: I have a friend who loves music.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'get along with…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I get along with…' to show you have a good relationship. Example: I get along with my classmates.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अच्छे संबंध दिखाने के लिए 'I get along with…' कहें। उदाहरण: I get along with my classmates.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 良い関係を表すとき「I get along with…」を使います。例: I get along with my classmates.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'have an argument with…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I had an argument with…' to describe a fight or disagreement. Example: I had an argument with my brother.

explanation_translation.Hindi: लड़ाई या असहमति बताने के लिए 'I had an argument with…' कहें। उदाहरण: I had an argument with my brother.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 口論や意見の不一致を言うとき「I had an argument with…」を使います。例: I had an argument with my brother.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'stay in touch with…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I stay in touch with…' to talk about continuing communication. Example: I stay in touch with my old teacher.

explanation_translation.Hindi: संपर्क बनाए रखने के लिए 'stay in touch with…' कहें। उदाहरण: I stay in touch with my old teacher.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 連絡を続けるとき「stay in touch with…」を使います。例: I stay in touch with my old teacher.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'respect' in sentences
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I respect…' to show admiration. Example: I respect my parents.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'I respect…' कहकर सम्मान दिखाएं। उदाहरण: I respect my parents.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 敬意を示すとき「I respect…」を使います。例: I respect my parents.
